name: AI Deco
description: Describe a style, press AI Deco in the editor, and an AI adds decoration around your layout.

api-url.name: API URL
api-url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (OpenRouter, OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama, etc.).

api-key.name: API Key
api-key.description: Your key for the provider above. Stored in your Geode save data. Never share your save folder.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model name exactly as your provider lists it.

style-prompt.name: Style Prompt
style-prompt.default: Technical black-and-white style: deep blacks, thin mechanical outlines, sharp white highlights, sparse orange accents.

deco-ids.name: Allowed Deco Object IDs
deco-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs the AI may use. Replace these with real deco IDs from the editor.

use-reference-image.name: Use Reference Image
use-reference-image.description: Attach the image picked with the Ref Image button. Needs a vision-capable model.

bpm.name: Song BPM
bpm.description: Beats per minute of the song. Used by the Beat FX button.

beat-offset.name: First Beat Offset (seconds)
beat-offset.description: Time from the start of the level to the first beat. Tune this by playtesting.

trigger-y.name: Trigger Height
trigger-y.description: Y position where triggers are placed (keep them out of the way).
